name: Jules Walters
occupation: State Representative; former mayor of West Linn

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature biography says Walters is a parent of four who served as mayor of West Linn.
bio.excerpt: as mayor of West Linn, a community of over 30,000 people.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists Walters's career as including administrative assistant, business owner, vice president of operations, and mayor of West Linn.
bio.excerpt: She served as mayor of West Linn.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Walters lists her occupation as state representative for House District 37, with a background as a small business owner.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, HD 37 Occupational Background: Small business owner

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

bio.statement: Walters lists the University of San Francisco and the University of Oregon.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: University of San Francisco, University of Oregon

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

bio.statement: Walters lists West Linn city councilor and mayor, and state representative for House District 37.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: City Councilor and Mayor, City of West Linn; State Representative HD 37

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: In March 2025 reporting republished by the Portland Tribune, Walters said substance use disorder is often thought of as an adult disease and that this is not how it works.
positions.excerpt: We think of (substance use disorder) as an adult disease, and that is not how it works.

source.publisher: Portland Tribune (The Lund Report)

positions.statement: Walters lists protecting the LGBTQ+ community, upholding immigrant and BIPOC rights and defending women's reproductive care among her values.
positions.excerpt: Protecting the LGBTQ+ community • Upholding Immigrant and BIPOC rights • Defending Women’s Reproductive Care

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Walters says she is working to make Oregon's schools safer and more accountable.
positions.excerpt: Making Oregon’s schools safer and more accountable.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Walters says as chair of the Early Childhood Committee her top priority is early learning and affordable childcare for all Oregonians.
positions.excerpt: As Chair of the Early Childhood Committee, her top priority is making early learning and quality, affordable childcare available for all Oregonians.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

positions.statement: Walters says she is working to make taxes fair and affordable as leader of the Measures 5/50 Study Group.
positions.excerpt: Working to make our taxes fair and affordable as leader of the Measures 5/50 Study Group.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 48

voting_record.statement: The Lund Report, republished by the Portland Tribune, identified Walters as one of the chief co-sponsors of a trio of 2025 bills on youth substance use.
voting_record.excerpt: "We just have these giant gaps for youth," said Walters, one of the bills' chief co-sponsors

source.publisher: Portland Tribune (The Lund Report)
